question: Can source-confirmed whole-parent imagery have a direct continuous representation with explicit extent and correspondence uncertainty, without discrete classes or complete named-feature vectors?
status: Post-exposure feasibility and sensitivity; not fresh independent confirmation.
source: All217 source-confirmed writing proposals in frozen Trial2:88 reference,129 fresh-for-Trial2 proposals. Exclude3 unresolved and1 nonwriting, enumerate exclusions. Keep11 writing-but-extent-uncertain cases; no source judgment modified.
selection: Reuse frozen source-only proposal corpus and frozen185 source pair judgments; pair selection previously pooled profile/contour/aspect selectors, not random independent new pairs. Trial2 contour superiority was already known and motivates this new trial.

representation.primary: Whole native mask/photo/coordinates remain primary evidence. Source-visible whole-parent certainty stored separately from raster alternatives. No splitting into inferred writing units.
representation.normalization: Fit tight ink envelope proportionally into56x56 support in64x64 canvas, centered, preserve aspect and orientation. No rotation/reflection or learned alignment. Native dimension/body proxy/provenance retained as metadata, not required named features.
representation.ambient_space: Binary image and normalized signed distance field at64x64; continuous image-function coordinates, not a semantic feature inventory. Source crops always retained to recover detail lost by normalization.
representation.metric: Primary symmetric64px contour Chamfer(normalized by56), including all raster boundaries. Secondary signed-distance-field RMS. No label-trained metric/PCA/clusters or feature weights.
representation.sensitivity: Separate32/128px primary-mask distance diagnostics and native±0.04 horizontal slant alternatives.64px is fixed primary; no resolution chosen by performance.
representation.not_semantics: Contours, interiors and negative space are raster geometry. No source-visible cavity, topology or connectivity truth follows from repeatability.

uncertainty.raster: At contrast6/12 retain every CC with>=5% primary-mask overlap. Include each candidate and, if split, a union preserving native relative placement. Retain IoU/split/merge/fragment/missing flags.5% is the existing correspondence diagnosis rule, not optimized here. A merged component remains a possible contaminated extent, never accepted solely by similarity.
uncertainty.parent_extent: Resolved frozen source extents vs extent-unknown/contact states. Observed candidate shapes for uncertain extents are provisional; complete-parent distance remains unbounded/unknown. Retain frozen N094/N095 possible-join hypothesis as partial union plus unknown bridge/ownership, never paint bridge or promote union to writing class.
uncertainty.distance_envelope: For source-resolved extents, report min/max over observed admissible raster/slant candidates along with primary distance. This is a sensitivity envelope, not a posterior/credible interval or proof candidates exhaust physical possibilities. Unknown full extent prevents a bounded physical distance regardless of finite observed-candidate envelope.
uncertainty.missing: No absent mask or parent-extent unknown mapped to zero distance. Representation-available differs from source-resolved and from correspondence-stable. No nearest match used to settle source contacts.

tests: per-parent threshold/split/merge/missing uncertainty and primary-to-alternative shape spread
source pair AUROC2vs0 and ordinal association on all available185 pairs; retain partial/U
paired six-caption bootstrap of primary contour AUROC; no comparison to Trial2 restricted99 subset
source-pair distance envelopes and interval-overlap/rank identifiability, separate from primary accuracy
source-resolved anchor cross-caption reference retrieval; whether primary-nearest remains certainly nearest under observed envelopes
32/64/128 metric sensitivity and slant sensitivity, no winner selection
exact shape/matrix replay, uncertainty guards and prior-freeze integrity
metrics: Primary binary score uses frozen54 same/67 different source pairs;64 partial excluded but enumerated. Same-AI ratings with prior exposure, reused anchors/references and six captions; bootstrap only conditional descriptive precision. No independent generalization claim.
freeze: Seal separate direct morphology Trial1 before any new downstream analysis. Earlier freezes/feature trials remain immutable. A continuous point or neighborhood is not a writing unit or equivalence class.
